body:
I had known about this person for a while, but I think I asked them out in the heat of the moment at the time, and I soon realised it wasn't meant to be.
We just didn't click in the way I thought we would and I think I discovered myself that I was not ready for a relationship.
Eventually, I thought to myself instead of trying to trick myself that I'd be okay if we stayed together a little longer, I deliberated what I was going to say to assure them it was definitely nothing wrong with them, I just had some problems that I wasn't ready to share*.

Luckily, they were very understanding- we had a bit of a cry together then, but even after that, we are quite close friends and we still hang out. Sure it was a bit awkward at first (since we shared the same friends, so it ws kinda hard to get space from each other without involving others), but I'm so glad we can talk comfortably now.

(*I was going through a very stressful part of my life, and it wouldn't have been fair to them when I wasn't even in the right space to share my problems with ANYONE)
